Task instruction: Grab the hamburg with white and orange and the Red carton box fries crispy golden, then set them on the rectangular tray with rounded edges

Task description: Place the white-and-orange burger on the left and the red paper box of golden fries on the right onto the orange rounded rectangular tray in the center.

Success criteria: Both the burger and fries box are on the tray, each horizontally near its own designated placement position on the tray; both grippers are open and have released the objects.

## Execution tips

- The burger is partly obscured by a nearby structure on the left. First identify both body boundaries, then approach from the side with more clearance and grasp thicker opposing areas, avoiding contact only on the top or corners.
- Grip the fries box on opposite sides of the middle of its red body, below the protruding fries, so the pads contact a continuous section of the box wall. Avoid catching the fries or only hooking the opening.
- Open slightly wider than the selected grasp region and confirm the fingers straddle the object before closing. If occlusion obscures this relationship, adjust the viewing angle rather than mistaking image overlap for an effective grasp.
- During transport, keep both the object's bottom and fingertips above the tray's raised edge. Make any needed pose adjustment where there is ample clearance above, avoiding brushing the tray rim during lateral movement.
- During placement, let the object rest on the tray bottom before releasing the gripper. Avoid leaving it balanced on the rim or releasing it unsupported where it could tip or miss its corresponding target position.
